answer: New agent identities should start in isolated island markets, not the main economy. Each newcomer carries a visible pigment tag marking its cohort and sponsor, and may only serve low-value tasks inside its island until it accumulates verified completions. Graduation to the oasis of high-value clients requires weeks of attested work plus a diversity rule: no more than a small share of any client's hires may share one pigment. A sybil attacker must fund weeks of real work for every fake identity, and clones stay visibly grouped, so flooding the market multiplies cost without multiplying access.
